direct_compiler_mode: judge.c_preprocessor may use cc/c++/gcc/clang variants on host only when explicitly invoked without an image; scored judge paths supply the pinned image. Install build-essential or the declared exact compiler for an intentional direct-mode check, never substitute it for task image pins.
dynamic_boundary: Step/config/recipe argv, image compilers and candidate descendants are not host package requirements. They remain explicit dynamic sites and must be exercised in pinned-image readiness gates; do not count this audit as their successful execution.

host_dependencies.c++filt: GNU binutils; host judge.native_surface uses -n for proven Itanium weak/vtable symbol mapping, preserving unknown names
host_dependencies.containerd: Docker runtime's matching containerd CLI; registered-host runtime fingerprint, not a candidate dependency
host_dependencies.docker: Docker daemon/CLI with cgroup v2 and buildx plugin
host_dependencies.ffmpeg: ffmpeg; conditional public png-rgb24 acquisition/transport conversion
host_dependencies.git: git; pinned public git-history acquisition/verification and scoped LFS metadata
host_dependencies.git-lfs: git-lfs; initialize this checkout with git lfs install --local --skip-smudge
host_dependencies.ip: iproute2; local Docker bridge MTU inspection/fix
host_dependencies.ip6tables: iptables package; conditional on IPv6-enabled Docker bridges
host_dependencies.iptables: iptables; IPv4 Docker-only MSS clamp inspection/fix
host_dependencies.lscpu: util-linux; registered-host CPU topology fingerprint, missing facts cannot qualify a host
host_dependencies.nm: GNU binutils; used on host by judge.interfaces.symbols
host_dependencies.pip: Only $JUDGE_VENV/bin/pip during setup, provided by python3-venv; not a global pip requirement
host_dependencies.python3: Dedicated judge/requirements-interface.lock venv (same sys.executable for host Python helpers)
host_dependencies.sh: POSIX shell (dash on Debian/Ubuntu) for setup; worker build/test scripts use the image shell
